about.bio_text:
Based in France, I'm currently a Partnership Manager and Developer at Apimo, a leading PropTech CRM platform. Having built my foundation here as a web developer, contributing tens of thousands of commits and millions of lines of code, I bridge the gap between technical engineering and strategic business growth.

I oversee the entire integration lifecycle for our partner ecosystem, collaborating with real estate portals, service providers, and AI companies. My work spans technical specification, API design, and full-stack development, ensuring seamless interoperability across our platform.

I'm inherently curious and always eager to try new things, a mindset rooted in my multicultural background, which also made speaking multiple languages second nature. Off-screen, that love for discovery shows up in my passion for travel, local food scenes, new technologies and design, as well as my work with generative AI art.
